description: This file defines interfaces, classes, enums, and structures related to the RRC (Radio Resource Control) User Equipment (UE) in a 5G/NR network, including handling of PDUs, NGAP messages, security, reconfiguration, and UE context management.

classes.name: rrc_ue_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling RRC UE, including stopping transactions.

classes.name: rrc_ul_pdu_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling uplink PDUs on logical channels.

classes.name: rrc_ngap_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling NGAP messages related to UE.

classes.name: rrc_pdu_f1ap_notifier
classes.description: Interface to notify F1AP about new SRB PDU.

classes.name: rrc_ue_setup_proc_notifier
classes.description: Interface to notify about UE setup procedures.

classes.name: rrc_ue_security_mode_command_proc_notifier
classes.description: Interface for security mode command notifications.

classes.name: rrc_ue_msg4_proc_notifier
classes.description: Interface for RRC reestablishment and resume procedures.

classes.name: rrc_ue_ngap_notifier
classes.description: Interface to notify about NGAP messages.

classes.name: rrc_ue_security_mode_command_context
classes.description: Structure for security mode command context.

classes.name: rrc_ue_context_update_notifier
classes.description: Interface for UE context update notifications.

classes.name: rrc_ue_interface
classes.description: Main interface aggregating all RRC UE functionalities.

methods.name: handle_dl_nas_transport_message
methods.description: Handle received Downlink NAS Transport message.

methods.name: get_packed_ue_radio_access_cap_info
methods.description: Get packed UE Radio Access Cap Info.

methods.name: on_new_rrc_pdu
methods.description: Notify about new RRC PDU for F1AP.

methods.name: on_new_dl_ccch
methods.description: Notify about new DL CCCH message.

methods.name: on_new_dl_dcch
methods.description: Notify about new DL DCCH message during reconfiguration.

methods.name: on_new_as_security_context
methods.description: Refresh AS security keys after derivation.

methods.name: on_ul_nas_transport_message
methods.description: Notify about uplink NAS transport message.

methods.name: get_cell_context
methods.description: Get cell context of RRC UE.

methods.name: update_cell_group_config
methods.description: Update packed RRC cell group config.

methods.name: get_cell_group_config
methods.description: Get packed RRC cell group config.

methods.name: is_rrc_inactive_supported
methods.description: Check if RRC Inactive is supported.

methods.name: is_conditional_handover_supported
methods.description: Check if Conditional Handover is supported.

methods.description: Check if CHO with event-A4 is supported.

methods.name: is_conditional_handover_location_based_supported
methods.description: Check if location-based CHO is supported.

methods.name: is_conditional_handover_time_based_supported
methods.description: Check if time-based CHO is supported.

methods.name: on_attempted_rrc_connection_establishment
methods.description: Notify about attempted RRC connection establishment.

methods.name: on_successful_rrc_connection_establishment
methods.description: Notify about successful RRC connection establishment.

methods.name: on_successful_rrc_connection_resume_with_fallback
methods.description: Notify about fallback during RRC resume.

methods.description: Notify about resume followed by RRC setup.
